story: Лунен Блясък is a music video where I joined the team as assistant and took charge of the color grade in DaVinci Resolve.
The goal of the grade was a soft moonlit look that keeps skin tones natural while letting the night exteriors and studio shots cut together cleanly.
A one minute color grading showreel will be added here once it is ready, with before and after stills from the sunset and studio setups.
